waller_condition_i_assessment: The Nov 2024 report prints Run Time 10:07PM and Run Date 11/05/2024, but its PDF CreationDate is 2024-11-09 21:59 UTC and its upload is 2024-11-10. I count condition (i) as met. Reasons: (1) DECISIONS 67 (i) asks for a printed run time OR an upload time on election night; the face of the report gives a printed run time on election night. (2) Unlike rule 47 for END/LIVE, the LATER reading has no clause by which a later known upload time defeats a printed time, so the Nov 10 upload does not cancel (i). (3) The two times measure different things: Waller's own 2026 Hart reports show the printed Run Time equal to the PDF CreationDate within about 2 minutes (3/11/2026 1:25 PM printed vs 18:27 UTC created; 06/02/2026 10:59 AM vs 16:00 UTC), so a 4-day gap means this copy was exported on Nov 9 from a report run at 10:07 PM on election night; the content (29 of 29 precincts, county totals) is the election-night count. Caveat: the file proves county totals existed at 10:07 PM on election night, not that they were posted online that night; that weakness is built into the rule's acceptance of printed times, and the resulting tag is low confidence. If the rule were read to treat CreationDate as the controlling printed time when it conflicts with the face time, (i) would fail and the election would be UNDETERMINED, making Waller UNKNOWN.
